note: Tier One is a hobby-only all-hits product (3 hits per 1-card-per-pack box, 2 autographs + 1 relic). New for 2026 is a 100-card base set: #1-20 Tier 1 legends, #21-70 Tier 2 current stars, #71-100 Tier 3 rookies (RC). On-card autograph sets (Tier One Autographs, Break Out, Prime Performers, Talent, Xplosion, etc.), autographed relics, and non-auto relic sets are all listed; base cards with BCA numbering are the Base Autographs. Dual/Triple autograph and dual-relic cards list all players on one entry. Cut Signatures include non-baseball figures. Parallels are omitted.
